comment: KOTOR III (fan) Nar Shaddaa landing pad. Hesk Varo, a Twi'lek ship broker, sells the crew the Far Lantern. Original writing for this fan project.

entries.text: There you are! Fuel cells full, hull patched, and your Mandalorian has already argued with my mechanic twice. The Far Lantern is waiting on you.
Paid for and waiting, friend, but my mechanic is still elbow-deep in her drive. Come back with your navigator once your business on the pad is settled.
Welcome, welcome! Hesk Varo, the finest hulls on this landing pad and the friendliest prices on any of them. What are we flying today?
Coordinates loaded and locked. She is all yours. Try to return her with most of her panels attached, or at least come back with a decent story.
Then you want the Far Lantern. An old long-range courier, plain as a cargo crate, but her drive will outlive both of us. Best range on the pad.
Your friend's shuttle in trade, plus a share of whatever you bring home. Done! Oh, and a woman in grey was here asking about your courier. I told her nothing, naturally.
Wrong? Nothing a coat of paint will not hide. Her last owner flew her far and hard, and she came back with stories nobody wanted to buy. The drive is flawless.
Last I saw, near the far stairs. Never smiled once. My mechanic needs a little time with the Lantern anyway. Come back when you are ready to fly.

replies.text: Load the coordinates. We leave now.
Something that can jump past the star charts and keep going.
She sounds right. What do you want for her?
Stories I can live with. Name your price.
A woman in grey? Where did she go?
